Subject: Problem with supplier invite — shows other tenant and 403 when switching

Hi Soojin,

We received the supplier portal invite for EverField today but when I click the activation link it lands on a tenant selector that lists multiple companies and when I try to select our company it redirects to a page with a 403. Screenshot attached (screenshot-403.png).

Steps I tried:
- Opened invite in incognito (same result)
- Tried different browser (Chrome, Firefox)
- Cleared cookies and retried

We need this resolved quickly so we can submit our W-9 and be set up for POs. Can you check whether the invite was issued to the canonical alias or if there was a tenant mapping problem? I can share the invite link and the header log if helpful — attaching the redirect log we captured (invite-log.txt).

Thanks,
Alex Gomez

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear repro and the logs. I’m sorry you hit this. We’ve looped in Ben (SSO/portal infra) and Rafael (integrations) to triage.

Ben/Rafael — forwarding the invite link and the redirect log. Can you confirm whether this is an alias/tenant mapping issue (similar to previous multi-tenant alias collisions) or something on the Coupa side? If it’s our invite being stamped with the wrong tenant alias we should reissue a corrected invite and invalidate the previous token.

Alex — quick follow-ups that help us triage faster: can you paste the full invite URL (you can paste privately if preferred) and confirm the email address the invite was sent to? Also, what browser + exact version did you try?

We’ll aim to have a mitigation plan within the next business day; if it’s a tenant alias fix we’ll coordinate with Coupa Support and either reissue the invite or provide a temporary manual activation.

Subject: Re: Problem with supplier invite — shows other tenant and 403 when switching

Team — I dug into the invite log. Short summary: the invite token is valid but the tenant alias embedded in the redirect is our legacy alias (everfield-old) not the canonical tenant alias (everfield-us). Coupa recently started honoring tenant aliases in the redirect flow, so if the browser sees a different host/tenant mapping it fails with a 403 rather than falling back.

Suggested immediate steps:
- Invalidate the current invite token (security) and reissue an invite stamped with everfield-us.
- If the supplier still sees the 403 after a new invite, have them clear cookies and use the invite in a fresh incognito window (we already asked them, but good to confirm after reissue).
- If reissue is blocked by the partner config, Rafael can escalate to Coupa Support to update the tenant mapping; I’ve drafted the required tenant alias change payload.

I’m attaching a screenshot from the repro that shows the tenant selector (screenshot-403.png). Rafael — can you open a Coupa support case and include the support-required fields (tenant id, current alias, desired alias, sample token)? If you want I can open the case and share the ticket number.
